title: Red Hat Security Advisory: perl-DBI security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities were identified in the perl-DBI package used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. The first allows loading arbitrary modules via unvalidated attributes in DBD::DBM (CVE-2026-78030). The second is a denial of service caused by an invalid memory read during numeric type casting (CVE-2026-88815). Red Hat has issued an important security update to address these issues.
